reason: My appointments already live in my scheduling/CRM tool, and this only books into Google Calendar, so I'd be running two systems and reconciling them on Sunday night. Two grand up front before I know it fits how we work is too much to commit to off a first look.
objection: If it books a slot my CRM doesn't know about, or tells a customer something wrong, I lose that customer, and I don't find out until they've gone to someone else.
would_change_my_mind: A direct sync with the scheduling/CRM tool I already use, plus a trial where I can listen to real recordings of how it handled my calls before I pay the full setup fee.
